name: social-button
title: Social Button
description: "Continue with <service>" button for third-party sign-in. An outline button (2px ink line, lettering label, hover, pressed, focus, loading and disabled exactly like the manga Button), 44px tall and full width by default. A logo slot at the start: a 20 × 20 paper plate that fits the given node in the box without recolouring it; the item ships no logo and no brand colour. AuthDivider is a horizontal fine ink rule with "or" in lettering in the middle. All Button props pass through; provider sets data-provider.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/social-button". Pass your own brand mark as logo; the mark is yours to supply.

meta.tagline: A sign-in button with a logo plate and an “or” rule.
meta.usage:
import { SocialButton, AuthDivider } from "@/components/manga/social-button"

<SocialButton provider="google" logo={<GoogleMark />}>Continue with Google</SocialButton>
<AuthDivider />
<SocialButton provider="apple" logo={<AppleMark />} loading>Continue with Apple</SocialButton>

props.name: logo
props.description: The brand mark, fitted into a 20 × 20 paper plate. Omit it for a button without a logo.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretches the button to the container width.

props.name: loading
props.description: Inherited from the manga Button: turning lines, aria-busy, clicks ignored.

props.name: label (AuthDivider)
props.description: Text in the middle of the divider; also its accessible label.
